name: Vectorized Front-to-Back Compositing
definition: A Python/NumPy implementation of front-to-back alpha compositing that processes all pixels in an image simultaneously using vectorized operations, rather than per-pixel loops.
summary: Vectorized Front-to-Back Compositing is a NumPy-based alpha compositing method that processes all pixels simultaneously, trading computational efficiency for code simplicity and gradient stability by skipping per-pixel early termination.
